source_name: Tracxn – FinTech startups in Slovakia list
why_relevant: Reports a long tail (~222) of SK fintech startups — far more than any local list — making it the broadest actor-discovery pointer for the small end of this cell, with funding-round metadata attached.

source_name: Crunchbase / PitchBook / Dealroom company profiles for SK fintech actors
why_relevant: Funding-round and headcount metadata for named cell actors (Vacuumlabs ~340 staff and ~$4.5M raised per the profiles found; Fumbi carries a PitchBook profile). Headcount trend plus round dates give the quantitative backbone against which qualitative hiring signals are scored. Dealroom aggregates cited ~200 tracked SK startups and ~$336M VC invested.

source_name: EU-Startups – Slovakia ecosystem coverage
why_relevant: English-language ecosystem roundups that name promising SK startups and cite Dealroom aggregates. Useful as an outside-in cross-check on the local actor map and for catching SK-founded firms that communicate mainly in English.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of SK fintech actors (e.g. FinTech Hub Slovakia, Startitup)
why_relevant: The cell rationale is explicit that these firms announce via founder posts rather than filings, and LinkedIn is where those posts live: new-role announcements, 'we're hiring' posts and headcount counters. Highest-recall channel for the weak signal — and the hardest to collect lawfully.

source_name: Innovate Slovakia / Slovak Investment Holding & state startup funding channels
why_relevant: State-backed programmes (Slovak Investment Holding, Venture to Future Fund) co-invest in SK startups; their announcements date funding events for firms too small for commercial databases, and 'come back' talent programmes signal senior returnee hires into the Bratislava ecosystem.

source_name: Profesia.sk — Banking sector job listings (Práca bankovníctvo)
why_relevant: Profesia is the dominant Slovak job board; its 'bankovníctvo' category is the single highest-frequency stream of SK banking vacancies (branch, product, risk, AML, IT). Volume and title mix are a near-real-time proxy for hiring intent and programme launches.

source_name: Profesia.sk — Employer profile pages (company ID pages)
why_relevant: Each employer has a stable C-ID page listing all its live vacancies. Enumerating bank/payments employer pages yields the full SK employer population in the sector and a per-employer hiring time series.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa career portal (TopJobs ATS)
why_relevant: SLSP is the largest SK bank (Erste Group). Its own ATS shows roles that never reach aggregators, and its retail-vs-centrála split reveals branch-network vs HQ/IT hiring balance.

source_name: Tatra banka / Raiffeisen banka SK career portal (Prirodzene najlepší)
why_relevant: Covers both Tatra banka and the Raiffeisen retail brand in SK. Observed role types (custody specialist, product manager digital assets, risk analyst, full-stack) directly signal product and programme direction.

source_name: VÚB banka — Voľné pozície (career portal)
why_relevant: Second-largest SK bank, Intesa Sanpaolo group; group-level roles also posted, exposing cross-border programme staffing (payments, AML, digital).

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko — Kariéra
why_relevant: KBC-group bank in SK; branch-network and HQ vacancies indicate distribution strategy and back-office restructuring. Group postings may route via csob.jobs.cz (LMC ATS).

source_name: 365.bank — Kariéra / voľné pozície (TopJobs ATS)
why_relevant: Digital-first SK bank (ex-Poštová banka); its hiring mix is a strong indicator of digital-channel and payments product build-out, and its 'pobočky' page maps the branch/Post partner network.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — Kariéra (central bank careers)
why_relevant: NBS vacancies (supervision, payment systems oversight, fintech/DORA/PSD3 units) reveal regulatory capacity build-up ahead of new supervisory regimes — a leading indicator for the whole sector.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia — vacancies (Profesia employer page)
why_relevant: Cross-border CZ/SK entity; SK-located postings distinguish local franchise hiring from group hub staffing.

source_name: Prima banka Slovensko — vacancies (Profesia employer page)
why_relevant: Retail/municipal-focused bank with dense branch network; teller and advisor posting volume is a direct read on branch-network expansion or contraction.

source_name: ING Hubs Slovakia — vacancies (Profesia employer page)
why_relevant: Large banking shared-service/tech hub in Bratislava; its payments, AML/KYC and engineering hiring reflects where a pan-European bank is relocating operations — a key nearshoring signal for SK.

source_name: Global Payments careers portal (locations incl. CEE)
why_relevant: Major card processor with CEE operations; role postings tagged to Slovakia/Czechia indicate processing, acquiring and terminal-estate activity relevant to the SK payments market.

source_name: Kariera.sk (Zoznam) — job offers portal
why_relevant: Second-tier SK board carrying employer and agency postings; useful for catching banks/fintechs that post off-Profesia and for agency-mediated confidential searches (often senior/leadership roles).

source_name: ISTP.sk — Internetový sprievodca trhom práce (vacancy database)
why_relevant: State-linked vacancy database combining labour-office data and direct employer postings; employers use it to meet the statutory duty to report vacancies, so it captures roles that never appear on commercial boards (branch, back-office, regional).

source_name: Jooble Slovakia — aggregated bank vacancies
why_relevant: Cross-board aggregator; useful as a breadth net and for detecting postings on boards not directly monitored. Counts are inflated/duplicated, so use for discovery, not measurement.

source_name: Práca za rohom — local/branch-level job listings
why_relevant: Geo-first board specialised in frontline roles (osobný bankár, pokladník). Best source for branch-network staffing signals at town level, which HQ-oriented boards under-represent.

source_name: Worki.sk — SK job portal (banking/finance categories)
why_relevant: Newer SK board with banking and finance categories; complements Profesia and may carry employers with exclusive or cheaper posting arrangements.

source_name: PozriPracu.sk — employer vacancy pages
why_relevant: Secondary aggregator with per-employer pages; useful as a redundancy check when a primary board or ATS is blocked or restructured.

source_name: eKariera.sk — employer career/company pages
why_relevant: Company-directory-style career site; its firm index is a pointer to SK financial employers and their recruiting brands.

source_name: LinkedIn company Jobs tabs for SK banks (e.g. Slovenská sporiteľňa)
why_relevant: Carries senior/HQ and group roles rarely on SK boards, and pairs vacancy data with people-movement signals (leadership moves). Access is heavily gated.

source_name: Erste Group careers — positions offered (group ATS covering SLSP)
why_relevant: Group-level ATS where cross-border programme roles (payments, instant payments, core banking) touching the Slovak subsidiary can appear before local posting.

source_name: Swiss Re Bratislava careers (financial-services shared-service hub)
why_relevant: Non-bank financial hub in Bratislava posting payments/cash-and-bank roles; a useful benchmark for the SK financial back-office labour market and competing employers for payments talent.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Largest SK bank (~3,500 staff, Erste Group). Company page carries official appointment posts, employer-brand content, 'we are hiring' posts and the LinkedIn-native headcount/employee-count curve that reveals org expansion or contraction before any press release.
